title: Property devissage on an irreducible closed support
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme], i.e. locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth] and quasi-compact [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], and let $T\subseteq X$ be an irreducible closed subset with generic point $\xi$ [def-weil-irreducible-components]. Let $\mathcal P$ be a property of coherent $\mathcal O_X$-modules [pqf-def-coherent] whose support $\operatorname{Supp}(\mathcal F)=\{x:\mathcal F_x\neq0\}$ [def-weil-pbc-closed-subset-proper-over-base](2) [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk] is contained in $T$, such that (1) for every short exact sequence $0\to\mathcal F_1\to\mathcal F_2\to\mathcal F_3\to0$ of coherent $\mathcal O_X$-modules with support contained in $T$, if two out of the three have $\mathcal P$ then so does the third; (2) for every closed immersion $i:Z\to X$ [def-weil-closed-immersion] with $Z$ an integral scheme [def-pc-integral-scheme] and $i(Z)\subsetneq T$, and every quasi-coherent sheaf of ideals $\mathcal I\subseteq\mathcal O_Z$, $\mathcal P$ holds for $i_*\mathcal I$ [def-pc-module-pullback]; (3) there is a coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module $\mathcal G$ such that (a) $\operatorname{Supp}(\mathcal G)=T$, (b) $\mathcal G_\xi$ is annihilated by the maximal ideal $\mathfrak m_\xi\subset\mathcal O_{X,\xi}$ [def-weil-residue-field], (c) $\dim_{\kappa(\xi)}\mathcal G_\xi=1$, and (d) $\mathcal P$ holds for $\mathcal G$. Then $\mathcal P$ holds for every coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module $\mathcal F$ with $\operatorname{Supp}(\mathcal F)\subseteq T$.

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 01YH (label lemma-property-irreducible, coherent.tex line 3179), including the comparison with G at the generic stalk and the proper-support quotient argument

proof.text: Choose $G$ from (3). The sequence $0\to G\xrightarrow{1}G\to0\to0$ and (1) give $\mathcal P(0)$. If $F\cong F\prime$ are coherent and supported in $T$, apply (1) to $0\to F\to F\prime\to0\to0$: property transfers in either direction. Thus the zero and isomorphism hypotheses needed below hold.

source.place: Tag 01YH, lemma-property-irreducible, first proof paragraph (zero and isomorphism cases made explicit)

proof.text: Apply [lem-pc-coherent-supported-property-devissage] with $S=T\setminus\{\xi\}$. Any integral closed-subscheme image contained in $S$ is properly contained in $T$, so hypothesis (2) supplies its ideal properties. Extension closure is the middle-term case of (1). We obtain $\mathcal P(Q)$ for every coherent $Q$ supported in $T$ with $Q_\xi=0$.

By [lem-weil-pbc-reduced-induced-closed-subscheme](2), give $T$ its reduced induced structure $i:Z\to X$. It is nonempty, reduced and irreducible, hence integral [def-pc-integral-scheme], and its generic point maps to $\xi$. Apply [lem-pc-coherent-rank-one-property-ideals] to $i$, $G$ from (3), the two-out-of-three hypothesis (1), and the small-support conclusion of Step 2. It gives $\mathcal P(i_*J)$ for every quasi-coherent ideal $J$ on $Z$.

source.place: Tag 01YH, lemma-property-irreducible, third and fourth proof paragraphs

proof.text: Apply [lem-pc-coherent-supported-property-devissage] with $S=T$. For an integral closed immersion $j:W\to X$ with $j(W)\subseteq T$, proper containment gives all its ideal properties by (2). If $j(W)=T$, the reducedness of $W$ and [lem-weil-pbc-reduced-induced-closed-subscheme](3) identify $W$ with $Z$ over $X$. Under this isomorphism a quasi-coherent ideal on $W$ becomes an ideal on $Z$, and their module pushforwards are isomorphic; Step 3 and Step 1 give its property. The devissage lemma now gives the assertion for every coherent $F$ supported in $T$.

proof_origin.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 01YH (lemma-property-irreducible), coherent.tex line 3179 and proof

split_report.summary: Repair of the released 2026-10-22 re-split order: two independent statement-only tasks, supported filtration devissage (old steps 1,2,6) and rank-one ideal property transfer (old steps 3,4,5). The parent is a short assembly. Its statement and all maintainer-owned fields are retained. The invalid all-zero-sequence justification was replaced using the given good G. Existing rank-one and common-lattice geometric lemmas are reused, not duplicated.
split_report.blueprint: The blueprint ancestor lem-pc-coherent-hi invokes the general proper-coherence input. Along its existing devissage route, the item realizes Tag 01YH inside lem-pc-coherent-property-devissage; new supported-filtration and rank-one-ideal tasks realize respectively the first/second/final and third/fourth paragraphs of its Stacks proof.

tool_uses.why: Generic construction and uniqueness of the reduced structure on T identify integral closed subschemes with the same underlying closed set; no in-unit node replaces it.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q63-fcf76ade6 (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: Read the item, both new nodes, the released 2026-10-22 re-split note and the old 6-step live proof, plus Stacks coherent.tex 01YG (l.3144) and 01YH (l.3179) with their proofs. Not superseded: live still has the 10-11 split and neither new id exists in live or side-live. The item statement and stmt_deps are unchanged (identical to live). Old steps 1, 2 and 6 (filtration induction with support control) go to new node lem-pc-coherent-supported-property-devissage: arbitrary support set S, P(0), iso invariance, extension closure, nonzero integral ideal pushforwards ⇒ P for every coherent module supported in S. It is true via the 01YF filtration node and the generic-stalk node, and it generalizes 01YG, which has no DAG node. Old steps 3 to 5 (01YE inclusion, r=1 from the 1-dimensional generic stalk, the cokernel vanishing at ξ, subideals, the I∩J sequences, J=0) go to new node lem-pc-coherent-rank-one-property-ideals. It is true. It is not a specialization of the 01YL node lem-weil-pbc-coherent-property-integral-ideals-of-small-support, which needs F^{⊕r}-descent and the higher-rank G' hypothesis, and it is not one of the patching nodes. The parent (1643 chars) is an assembly. Step 1 gets P(0) and iso invariance from 0→G→G→0→0, fixing the old all-zero argument. Step 2 applies the devissage node with S=T∖{ξ}: an integral image in S misses ξ, so it is a proper subset of T and (2) applies. Step 3 builds T_red with reduced-induced(2), which is integral by def-pc-integral-scheme, and supplies every hypothesis of the rank-one node from Step 1, (1), Step 2 and (3). Step 4 applies the devissage node with S=T, using reduced-induced(3) to transport the full-support case to Z. The two nodes are comparable in size (about 2:1), statement-only, self-contained, with exact stmt_deps, three kinds of search, correct created/blueprint fields, no cycles and no SGA. Edge cases tested: S empty or not closed, X=Z=Spec k, Spec k[ε], G=i_*I, J=0 and J=O_Z. Accepted tool use: lem-weil-pbc-reduced-induced-closed-subscheme. Cosmetic only, not repaired: F\prime in step 1, and the new nodes' from.place names 01YH paragraphs.

lean.statement: theorem coherent_property_irreducible (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X] (T : Set X) (hTclosed : IsClosed T) (hTirreducible : IsIrreducible T) (ξ : X) (hξ : IsGenericPoint ξ T) (P : X.Modules → Prop) (hshort : ∀ S : ShortComplex X.Modules, S.ShortExact → RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace S.X₁ → RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace S.X₂ → RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace S.X₃ → {x : X | ¬ Subsingleton (S.X₁.presheaf.stalk x)} ⊆ T → {x : X | ¬ Subsingleton (S.X₂.presheaf.stalk x)} ⊆ T → {x : X | ¬ Subsingleton (S.X₃.presheaf.stalk x)} ⊆ T → ((P S.X₁ ∧ P S.X₂) → P S.X₃) ∧ ((P S.X₁ ∧ P S.X₃) → P S.X₂) ∧ ((P S.X₂ ∧ P S.X₃) → P S.X₁)) (hsmaller : ∀ (Z : Scheme.{u}) (i : Z ⟶ X), IsClosedImmersion i → IsIntegral Z → Set.range i.base ⊂ T → ∀ I : Z.IdealSheafData, P ((pushforward i).obj I.toModules)) (hG : ∃ G : X.Modules, RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace G ∧ {x : X | ¬ Subsingleton (G.presheaf.stalk x)} = T ∧ (∀ a ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk ξ), ∀ v : (RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace ξ).obj G, a • v = 0) ∧ (∃ inst : Module (X.residueField ξ) ((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace ξ).obj G), (∀ (a : X.presheaf.stalk ξ) (v : (RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace ξ).obj G), a • v = (X.residue ξ) a • v) ∧ Module.finrank (X.residueField ξ) ((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace ξ).obj G) = 1) ∧ P G) : ∀ F : X.Modules, RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace F → {x : X | ¬ Subsingleton (F.presheaf.stalk x)} ⊆ T → P F
